trainer_scp.name: Officer Jenny
abilities: anomalous coordination with multiple Jenny instances
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T021 is not to be contained. SCP-T021 may be deployed for emergency response to SCP breaches involving human casualties.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T021 is one of many identical parahuman instances serving in law enforcement roles. All instances share identical genetic structure and display coordinated tactical behavior despite no known communication link.
trainer_scp.behavior_notes: Disciplined, authoritative, and calm under pressure. Shows no awareness of other SCP-T021 instances.
addendum_logs: Addendum T021-A: Three SCP-T021 instances responded simultaneously to a breach despite being kilometers apart.
Addendum T021-B: SCP-T021 resisted SCP-0092 (Gastly)’s fear hallucinations with no measurable effect.

trainer_scp.name: Tracey Sketchit
abilities: anomalous ability to detect hidden anomalies
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T022 must not be allowed to sketch restricted SCP entities without authorization.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T022 possesses anomalous visual cognition, capable of identifying structural weaknesses and hidden features in SCP entities. Sketches produced by SCP-T022 contain details not visible to sensors.
trainer_scp.behavior_notes: Curious, observant, and highly focused. Displays compulsive sketching behavior.
addendum_logs: Addendum T022-A: SCP-T022’s sketch revealed an unseen appendage on SCP-0049 (Venomoth).
Addendum T022-B: SCP-T022 identified a cloaked surveillance drone by sound alone.

trainer_scp.name: Ritchie
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T023 may assist in calming distressed anomalies. Personnel must avoid exposing SCP-T023 to high-threat SCPs without supervision.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T023 displays anomalous synchronization with parahuman creatures, allowing coordinated movement and reduced aggression. Frequently forms stable bonds with volatile anomalies.
addendum_logs: Addendum T023-A: SCP-T023 synchronized movement with SCP-0054 (Psyduck) during a psychic burst.
Addendum T023-B: SCP-0121 (Starmie) reduced pulse frequency in SCP-T023’s presence.

trainer_scp.name: Duplica
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: Personnel must verify identity when interacting with SCP-T024. SCP-T024 must not be allowed near SCP-0132 (Ditto) unsupervised.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T024 is a parahuman capable of mimicking voices, mannerisms, and appearances with near-perfect accuracy. Mimicry extends to anomalous behavioral patterns.
trainer_scp.behavior_notes: Playful, theatrical, and mischievous. Displays compulsive impersonation tendencies.
addendum_logs: Addendum T024-A: SCP-T024 impersonated a Level-3 researcher and bypassed two checkpoints.
Addendum T024-B: SCP-T024’s mimicry confused SCP-0132, causing unstable transformations.

trainer_scp.name: Todd Snap
abilities: photographs reveal hidden spectral or psychic signatures
anomalous ability to capture anomalies without distortion
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T025 must not photograph restricted SCPs without authorization. Cameras used by SCP-T025 must be monitored for anomalous output.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T025’s photographs reveal details invisible to sensors, including spectral residue, psychic fields, and cloaked appendages. SCP-T025 displays extreme reflexes when capturing anomalies in motion.
addendum_logs: Addendum T025-A: SCP-T025 captured a clear image of SCP-0094 (Gengar) mid-phase.
Addendum T025-B: SCP-T025’s camera detected a hidden glyph on SCP-0065 (Alakazam).

trainer_scp.name: Casey
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: Personnel must avoid exposing SCP-T026 to large crowds or emotionally volatile anomalies.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T026’s emotional state directly influences nearby anomalies, amplifying aggression, excitement, or fear. Displays energy projection during extreme emotional spikes.
addendum_logs: Addendum T026-A: SCP-T026’s excitement caused SCP-0058 (Growlithe) to ignite containment padding.
Addendum T026-B: SCP-T026 unintentionally triggered a panic response in 14 personnel.

trainer_scp.name: Yellow
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T027 may assist in calming or healing distressed anomalies. Personnel must avoid exposing SCP-T027 to hostile psychic SCPs.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T027 displays anomalous empathic abilities capable of stabilizing emotional states in humans and anomalies. Frequently neutralizes aggression in volatile SCPs.
addendum_logs: Addendum T027-A: SCP-T027 calmed SCP-0068 (Machamp) during a rage event.
Addendum T027-B: SCP-0148 (Dragonair) displayed atmospheric stabilization in SCP-T027’s presence.

trainer_scp.name: Blue (Female)
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: Personnel must avoid engaging SCP-T028 in strategic contests. SCP-T028 must not be allowed access to SCP containment schematics.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T028 displays exceptional strategic intelligence and manipulative capability. Frequently outmaneuvers hostile anomalies and personnel alike.
addendum_logs: Addendum T028-A: SCP-T028 predicted SCP-0149 (Dragonite)’s movement patterns with 94% accuracy.
Addendum T028-B: SCP-T028 manipulated a guard into revealing restricted information.

trainer_scp.name: Red
abilities: anomalous bond strength with high-threat anomalies
resistance to psychic and elemental attacks
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T029 must not be engaged directly. Personnel must avoid provoking SCP-T029 or interfering with bonded anomalies.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T029 is an apex-level parahuman with unmatched combat ability and anomalous synergy with multiple high-threat SCP entities. Displays near-superhuman resilience and precision.
addendum_logs: Addendum T029-A: SCP-T029 neutralized SCP-0142 (Aerodactyl) during an uncontrolled flight event.
Addendum T029-B: SCP-T029 resisted SCP-0097 (Hypno)’s psychic pulse with no measurable effect.

trainer_scp.name: Green (Male)
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T030 must be monitored during interactions with SCP-T028 and SCP-T029. Personnel must avoid exposing SCP-T030 to high-threat anomalies.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T030 is a rogue parahuman with exceptional improvisational skill and anomalous luck. Frequently escapes containment scenarios through unpredictable methods.
addendum_logs: Addendum T030-A: SCP-T030 escaped a locked containment room using improvised tools.
Addendum T030-B: SCP-T030 survived SCP-0100 (Voltorb) detonation with minor injuries.
